question: Should Skill Workshop permanently add a core review projection and bind pending approval decisions to the reviewed proposal version?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and well-proven, but the fail-closed approval behavior and new cross-surface contract require maintainer product intent rather than an automated merge decision.

options.title: Accept the core contract
options.body: Keep the canonical preview service, optional direct-call version parameter, and mandatory version binding for pending approval snapshots.

options.title: Land preview only
options.body: Keep read-only create and update previews but defer approval-snapshot binding for a separate compatibility decision.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Retain summary-only approvals and close both this PR and the linked feature request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Accept the core contract
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical preview service, optional direct-call version parameter, and mandatory version binding for pending approval snapshots.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly routed the new core Skill Workshop contract to this reviewer, providing the strongest available product-direction ownership signal.
